headline: Frontline Fighting Rages Across Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Fresh tactical engagements have erupted across Callahan's Passage and Callum's Cape, while sustained fighting continues to batter Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm. Over the past two hours, Callahan's Passage witnessed renewed base contestation around Crumbling Post alongside nearly 3,000 combined casualties, leaving one position in neutral ruins. Callum's Cape also saw sudden action with four rapid base transitions at Scouts Jest. In Weathered Expanse, where two strategic strongholds remain reduced to no-man's-land, another 3,400 casualties and three base exchanges unfolded over the last two hours, led by clashes at Crow's Nest and Wightwalk. Palantine Berm recorded six base flips in two hours across The Droll and Leiri Hermanni, maintaining heavy pressure on the front. Meanwhile, tempo slowed in Stlican Shelf with only a single base shift, though enlistments rose, and high-attrition artillery exchanges continue across Linn of Mercy and Nevish Line without recent territorial alterations.
